meta.purpose: NHL regression gate. Each fixture is an input the live NHL engine maps to a team. Any future change to src/data/nhl.js scoring (or the shared fingerprint engine in src/lib/scoring.js) must reproduce every winner here, or the diff must be reviewed and accepted.
meta.source: Baselined at the NHL convergence build (32 teams, 12 module questions, sliders nhl_q3/q6/q9). NHL is a fingerprint sport like NFL/MLB/NBA: coreProfile vs teamDims plus module-point tiebreakers. One honest scoring fix during the gate: Boston was swallowed by Philadelphia (near-identical rows); re-keyed BOS q4 E->A ('it lasts') and q7 B->A ('does both halves, the standard') onto genuinely-Boston pedigree cells (BOS self-reach 0%->65%). Post-build HARD Lane gate (anchor-calibrated to Serie A ROM 82.7% / NAP 95.4%): 32/32 signatures self-land, zero swallowed, Lane floor CHI ~36% (bar ~7%), uniform top magnet LAK ~6.2%. | Re-baselined at the slider-footprint redesign: nhl_q3/q6/q9 replaced 3 flat buckets with honest per-team footprints (peak at the team's trait position, lean by boundary). 17 signature answers moved to new peaks; 12 random winners re-recorded.
meta.synthetic_caveat: Signatures pin coreProfile to each team's own teamDims and use that team's signature module answers; they measure ENGINE BEHAVIOR (reachability), not real-taker prevalence. Random fixtures are seeded uniform inputs generated and replayed on the CURRENT engine. Reachability is not prevalence.
meta.signature_method: coreProfile = teamDims; moduleAnswers = the option the team sits in per choice question, strong end (1 or 5) of its slider camp, neutral 3 where the team is off the slider.
